jobs_results.title: System-Hardware Product/Quality Assurance Senior Engineer
jobs_results.description:
System-Hardware Product/Quality Assurance Senior Engineer

DEIMOS is selecting engineers for its Flight Directorate, forming part of the Space Systems Business Unit at our Tres Cantos premises or Puertollano facilities.

The work of the SS division is oriented to the specification, design, development, Assembly, Integration, Testing and Operations of complete spacecraft and associated tools as GSE.

As a member of the Space Systems Business Unit, you will work in a team of other highly skilled engineers across Europe (Spain, Portugal, UK, Romania), working on projects covering applications such as:
• Earth Orbit (LEO), MEO, GEO or Deep Space satellites, constellations or spacecrafts for private and institutional customers
• observation, Communications, Navigation, Science and IOD programmes
• projects with special focus on space technologies
• and Lunar exploration missions
• Debris mitigation, contributing to a sustainable space.

The selected candidates shall be integrated into an... international team of highly qualified engineers and exceptional human quality. Likewise, Deimos’ transnational condition, could allow the candidate international mobility, developing his work from any of the company headquarters.

Main Duties:

To support System Engineering, Procurement and MAIT (Manufacturing Assembly Integration and Test) areas in projects of Space Systems BU missions, programs, and products, covering all phases (0 to F), for traditional and New Space mission’s profiles, in one or more of the following technical disciplines or domains:
• components & EEE QA engineering, including Complex Devices development (FPGA, ASIC, IP Cores) and use of COTS (Components Off-The Shelf)
• (Radiation Hardness Assurance) engineering
• & Reliability Assurance engineering
• and Processes QA engineering
• Validation and Qualification of flight HW (& SW)
• & Development Assurance levels for HW (& SW)
• Based Mission Assurance (MBMA), as part of Model Based System framework (MBSF)
• and Critical items management

To apply current and future corporative Company Management System (CMS) and specific Directorates and BU’s Engineering Quality directives and processes definitions, collaborating in a continuous improvement environment for multidisciplinary engineering areas, including stablished Chief Engineering and Quality functions coordination and roadmaps, for missions and products under Company strategy and objectives

Education:

Required: A recognized engineering degree (Computer Sciences, Electrical, Electronic, Telecommunications) with demonstrable experience in space systems and hardware engineering.

Familiarity with space product assurance practices together with a good working knowledge of appropriate working tools.

Appreciated: Postgraduate studies (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) with a focus on system, hardware or/and embedded software engineering, space products or satellite systems design.

Professional Experience:

Required: Engineer with minimum experience of 3 to 5 years in the practical application of the domains relevant to the post (experience obtained while obtaining relevant M.Sc. & PhD studies could also be considered as applicable for the position).

Knowledge and proven experience in the following areas:
• and/or chairing of related project and internal reviews and boards
• management of complex systems, equipment and devices.
• and Hardware engineering, with application of Mission and Product Assurance support, in critical applications.
• to work autonomously and in multidisciplinary teams
• and Coordination of designated PA & QA teams, including internal (or external) specialists for technical areas, to support project phases, peer and customer reviews
• of ECSS or suitable standards (NASA, IPC, CNES, DLR, etc).
• and management of related requirements and specifications

Appreciated: Specific experience or knowledge of the following areas would be considered as an asset for this position:
• methodology and practices
• Based System Engineering / Model Based Mission Assurance
• Twins definition and application during related phases
• assurance for space projects
• systems architectures and life-cycles
• Engineering, spacecraft budgets and spacecraft reliability
• flowchart and activities
• during Launch, LEOP, commissioning and operational phases
• or preparation of Qualification, OTS and Safety suitability reports

Technical Requirements:

Required: The following capabilities are required for the position:
• to support the system, hardware and software teams along the project, contributing to the flow down of related PA and QA requirements, techniques and methods to the Mission/System/HW/SW/FW development, V&V and Qualification processes.
• of PA&QA technical disciplines and domains, as part of main duties, including Dependability and Safety (RAMS) and FDIR strategy implementation methodologies and Mission-HW-SW relevant analysis.

Desired: Experience in some of the following fields is desired but not indispensable:
• of EDA and simulation tools, at different levels of mission and product breakdown.
• with aerospace sector and/or safety critical software development
• in the application of PA techniques and methods in critical (or safety critical) software and hardware following relevant standards (e.g. ECSS-Q-ST-80C, DO-178B/C, DO-254).
• and Application of HW DAL methodologies for Avionics and related subsystems and equipment (DO-254)

Appreciated: Experience in any of the following would be viewed positively:
• SW and Systems design and requirements management documentation methodologies and tools: UML, SysML, DOORS, Capella, ValiSpace.
• of HW and SW Metrication tools, IDE and Agile methodologies
• programming skills (C, C++, plus potentially others as VHDL, Python or Ada) and knowledge of software configuration control and management (GIT, SVN).
• of ISVV methodologies and SW DAL categorization (DO-178)
• of SW Coding Standards (MISRA-C) and SW/FW Development Standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-HB series, ECSS-Q-60).

Language Skills:

English (Native or High level, spoken and written). Appreciated: Spanish.

Personal Skills:
• about Engineering Quality Assurance and continuous improvement.
• to integrate in and work within a multidisciplinary team, in a collaborative international environment with full responsibility on specific areas of the work under development.
• autonomy and self-development. Rigor, commitment and reliability in the execution of the assigned tasks.
• towards the customer and colleagues. Proactive attitude to solve problems, identify priority actions and handle concurrent activities and deadlines.
• to participate in multiple projects or areas of activity.

HRRECRUIT- 892

jobs_results.title: Python Software Engineer - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Team
jobs_results.description:
Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware.

The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: https://ubuntu.com/certified

We design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the... Americas and APAC.

We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.

Role description

We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.

The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.

Key responsibilities
• Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.
• Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
• Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
• Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
• Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.

Required Skills And Experience
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
• Interest in test automation methodologies.
• Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
• Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.

Desired Skills And Experience
• Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
• Experience working in an agile environment.
• Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
• Familiarity with the C programming language.

What is Canonical?

Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

#Stack

jobs_results.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs_results.description:
En Premium PSU nos gustan los retos. Somos especialistas en el diseño y fabricación de sistemas de conversión de alta potencia. Estamos presentes en diferentes sectores dentro del mercado industrial ofreciendo soluciones para aplicaciones high-tech, ferroviarias, energéticas o en entornos seguros. Contamos con más de 40 años de experiencia y un equipo altamente capacitado nos ha permitido posicionarnos como líderes tecnológicos en soluciones de energía para el mercado industrial, donde desarrollamos productos para aplicaciones en maquinaria high-tech, ferroviarias, energéticas o en ambientes extremos.

Nuestra gama de productos se compone de convertidores DC/DC, fuentes de alimentación ininterrumpida, inversores DC/AC, variadores de frecuencia AC/AC, rectificadores, fuentes de alimentación AC/DC y cualquier solución que requiera alta fiabilidad desde 50W hasta 72kW. Disponemos de una amplia gama de productos estándar y hemos desarrollado más de 900 diseños a medida a lo largo de los... años, garantizando la calidad desde el diseño y durante todo el proceso de fabricación. Todos los proyectos, desde el concepto, diseño y homologación del producto, se realizan en Barcelona.

Fruto de nuestro carácter disruptivo, en 2022 lanzamos una nueva línea de productos para proporcionar estaciones de carga rápida DC para vehículos eléctricos, que distribuimos bajo una banda de nueva creación: Floox.

¿Te unes a nuestro reto?

MISIÓN:

Como Hardware Engineer desarrollarás y crearás equipos de electrónica de potencia dentro de la gama de producto Premium PSU. Colaborarás para conseguir con éxito la gestión, coordinación y desarrollo del proyecto asignado. Buscamos una persona con alta capacidad de resolución y toma de decisiones

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES & RESPONSABILIDADES:
• Colaborar en la definición de productos (estudio de costes, viabilidad...).
• Diseñar/crear las variaciones de producto estandar para las adaptaciones a las especificaciones de cada cliente y/o proyecto.
• Colaborar desde el punto de vista técnico en las homologaciones de cliente.
• Diseño del producto asignado incluyendo: documentación, layout, simulación, test internos y externos, validación, prototipos y puesta a punto.
• Redacción de los manuales de usuario, fichas técnicas de producto, manual de seguridad, esquemas eléctricos...
• Realizar homologaciones de componentes alternativos (eléctricos, electrónicos y mecánicos).
• Proponer mejoras para reducción de costes en materiales (eléctricos, electrónicos y mecánicos).
• Asegurar que el equipo/producto esta llega a buen termino respecto a diseño, manufactura, tiempos, presupuesto, calidad y seguridad.
• Coordinación transversal con otros equipos involucrados en el desarrollo y comercialización de los productos.
• Asegurar el cumplimiento de las especificaciones del cliente y de las normativas requeridas para el nuevo equipo.
• Cumplir los objetivos de tiempo de desarrollo pactados.

REQUISITOS:
• Grado en ingeniería electrónica o afines, preferiblemente con especialización en electrónica de potencia, control digital y/o similares.
• Experiencia de 3 o más años en posición similar.
• Experiencia en programación de microcontroladores y simulación de elementos finitos (térmica y de fluidos).
• Alta capacidad de resolución y toma de decisiones.

CONOCIMIENTOS REQUERIDOS:
• Diseño de circuitos electrónicos
• Simulación de circuitos electrónicos
• Matlab-Simulink
• Solid Edge
• PSim
• Altium Designer
• EMI/EMC
• DFMEA
• Programación de microcontroladores
• DAFO

BENEFICIOS:
• Incorporación a empresa líder en su sector con posibilidades reales de crecimiento profesional.
• Política de teletrabajo.
• Opcióna obtener un Plan de carrera profesional.
• Horario de trabajo flexible de lunes a viernes de 6:45 a 15:15.
• Flexibilidad horaria y conciliación de vida familiar.
• Ambiente profesional y excelentes condiciones de trabajo.
• Fruta fresca un día a la semana.
• Café y té gratuitos disponibles.
• Descuento en menús saludables/comida casera.
• Clases de Inglés gratuitas.
• Acceso a Retribución flexible.
• Política de vacaciones flexible.
• Salario competitivo acorde experiencia y valor aportado.
• Sala Take it Easy: contamos con un espacio para poder romper con la rutina y salir del estrés. El espacio incluye todo tipo servicios relacionados con el Ocio: Música, proyecciones audiovisuales, lectura, videojuegos, guitarra, bebidas refrescantes y hasta una mesa de ping pong!

¡Únete a nuestro equipo!

#somospremium

Premium no solo reconoce que su personal es fundamental para su éxito, sino que se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Los procesos de selección siempre se llevan a cabo sin importar raza, color, ascendencia, religión, sexo, origen nacional, orientación sexual, edad, ciudadanía, estado civil, discapacidad o identidad de género.

Nos importan las personas como factor imprescindible para el crecimiento y evolución de la compañía, así como de las personas que la componen

jobs_results.title: Research Engineer/Researcher - Software/hardware engineers for...
jobs_results.description:
Context And Mission

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) www.bsc.es is embarking on an umbrella of large-scale projects to contribute in the BSCs next generation supercomputer, the Marenostrum 6 (MN6), which will be operational in 2028/2029. In this ambitious and potentially rewarding endeavor, we need engineers and computer scientists at all levels of expertise (from 0 to 20+ years) and in both software and hardware fields. The final team will be around 100 engineers and scientists. The applicants would ideally have experience/ambition in at least one or more of the following fields:

· System software (operating system), including the development of new Linux services, tools, and drivers. Service visualization and containerization. Good understanding of the Linux kernel.

· Compilers, including the development of the LLVM compiler to target new features and/or optimizations (aimed at improving the performance of applications that are currently exploiting the RISC-V ISA).

·... Parallel libraries and runtimes, including the development of new features and extensions in parallel library/runtime’s systems for HPC programming models (e.g., MPI, OpenMP, SyCL), and workflow executions (e.g., COMPSs).

· Parallel numerical frameworks, including the use and development of numerical libraries (e.g., BLIS, OpenBLAS), and data analytic frameworks (e.g., Pythorch, Tensor Flow).

· HPC analysis, including the performance analysis of HPC applications, as well as the development of new tools (e.g., Extrae/Paraver) and benchmarks that may help to characterize the system behavior.

· HPC application engineering, including the understanding of actual scientific HPC applications (usually written in C/C++ and Fortran), and the development of modifications/extensions that may improve their performance.

jobs_results.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

The path towards a new era of full autonomous vehicles is already set and the rise of central computing paradigms is accelerating the introduction of new in-vehicle networking (IVN) technologies required for the vehicle of the future, like automotive ethernet and SERDES.

To help us develop these concepts, we @Technica-Engineering are building a completely new engineering team located in Barcelona area, and working closely in contact with company headquarters in Munich. This is going to be an interdisciplinary team composed by hardware and software experts focused in the development of company own product roadmap and ProofOfConcepts and Prototypes for clients, mostly OEMs.

What We Offer

Therefore, to build up this team, if you are interested in vehicle connectivity technologies, central computing paradigms and the new mobility trends we are looking for a passionate hardware engineer specialized in electronics to join the team and help us:
• Opportunity to be closer... to main market trend in automotive market within a company working as pure R&D partner for main European OEM.
• High diversity of state-of-the-art projects with technologies 3-4 years beyond what is currently in series production vehicles.
• Opportunity to work in an international environment within a diverse team in close collaboration with our Munich offices. International mobility options available to discuss case-by-case.
• Total integration within the product planning team working in close contact with experienced engineers.
• Professional career development plan tailored individually to maximize opportunities of employee growth.
• Opportunity to further expand your training, from personal abilities to technical areas.
• Opportunity to participate in the growth of a new engineering team from the ground up.
• Company culture oriented to research engineering with a clear reinvestment mindset. Company made by engineers and managed by engineers.
• Attractive professional career development inside the HW group
• Additional extra hours as vacation in exchange.
• Regular team building activities with specific company budget.
• 30 working days as holidays, with full flexibility to manage them.

Main Functions
• Participate in system architecture definition at early project phases and in pure research projects with non-fixed requirements at project kick-off. In this kind of project, be able to give appropriate feedback to customer and internal stakeholders to assure best architecture selection.
• Lead hardware designs, in terms of component selection, schematic creation and PCB layout routing according to the defined processes and procedures. In case PCB layout is done by another engineer or third-party, give support to PCB team according specific power requirements and EMC good practices.
• As a Senior member one of your main tasks consist on support technically but also organizational the other members of the group, focusing also on less experienced members, helping and mentoring them.
• Understand globally product requirements and system architecture with a global view to perform and appropriate hardware design.
• Lead hardware designs, in terms of component selection, schematic creation and PCB layout routing according to the defined processes and procedures. In case PCB layout is done by another engineer or third-party, give support to PCB team according specific power requirements and EMC good practices.
• Be able to make worst case calculation, power deratings & simulations if required to assure design robustness.
• Prepare and execute test plan to assure design quality with specific hardware testing of each block. Perform investigation activities during hardware bring-up and identify and fix problems found on validation or by external parties in the assigned electronic system.
• Prepare EMC/Electrical/ESD test plan and coordinate test activities as well as investigation activities if required.
• Validate and analyze hardware prototype and assure a robust HW-SW integration.
• Technical support within area of expertise to other team members.
• Perform research into new technologies, ideas and trends within your area of expertise and attend relevant conferences or seminars to ensure the organization remains up to date with current technological developments and in the state of the art of all emerging technologies.
• Participate in demos of team capabilities to company management and to customers with creation of prototype setups, sometimes to be presented in fairs where the company is present too.
• Generate accurate periodic reporting of progress and blocking points, to be able to communicate efficiently with the team and with our customers.

Job requirements

Requirements / Skills
• At least 5+ years experience in the development and/or design of hardware for electronic devices.
• Good team first player with strong analytical and investigation skills to work in research projects with new technologies in early design phases.
• Experience leading HW groups with focus on fast prototype and flexible HW development.
• Experience in complex projects with multiple power rails at different voltages and complex architectures with combination of several switching and linear regulators for complex SOC & FPGA devices.
• Experience in low noise and EMI optimization of DC/DC converters and in general hands-on experience on EMI/EMC analysis of power electronics designs.
• Knowledge of thermal management risks and challenges as well as practical knowledge of component selection, thermal modelling, heatsink calculations, etc., to assure performance in intended operation temperature range of the design.
• Knowledge of how to optimize circuit design for ease of manufacturing processes and electronics testing (DFM / DFT).
• Experience and ability to use any kind of laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, active/passive/current probes, power supplies, electronic loads, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers).
• Precise soldering skills (SMD components, fine pitch ICs).
• Knowledge of all switched mode power supply topologies used in automotive designs.
• Experience in power-supply requirements specific for automotive applications, wide input voltage range, cold-cranking, load dump, high voltage protections, quiescent current restrictions, etc. is desirable.
• Knowledge of different communication bus interfaces: I2C, SPI, CAN, CAND-FD, LIN, FLEXRAY, Automotive Ethernet, etc., is desirable.
• Knowledge of specific automotive test regulations (pulses and transient testing, fast voltage drops and micro-interruptions, BCI, EMC/ESD automotive regulations,…) is desirable.
• Practical knowledge of functional safety standards such as ISO26262 is desirable.
• Experience in power integrity design and simulation tools (to analyze voltage drop and current density capacity of power rails, IC switching noise propagation though boards, PDN impedance across different frequencies, etc.) is desirable.
• Experience with Flotherm, Icepak or similar thermal modelling packages is a bonus.
• Fluency in English is a must, German is nice to have. All our customers are from outside Spain.

For additional information in case you want to know more about us, check our website

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de Compatibilidad Electromagnética (EMC)
jobs_results.description:
En el equipo de Hardware y Compatibilidad Electromagnética de IKERLAN somos especialistas en el desarrollo de hardware para sistemas electrónicos que requieren el cumplimiento de los requisitos funcionales y no funcionales más exigentes para un amplio abanico de aplicaciones y sectores industriales y utilizando los componentes más avanzados. Participamos en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de desarrollo: desde la especificación de requisitos hasta la verificación de prototipos y su integración con el firmware y el resto de subsistemas con los que interactúan, pasando por la selección de componentes, el diseño de esquemáticos y el layout de PCBs. Nuestros laboratorios de montaje y de compatibilidad electromagnética (EMC) nos permiten acortar los ciclos de desarrollo y garantizar la robustez de nuestros diseños.

En esta ocasión queremos potenciar nuestras capacidades para garantizar la compatibilidad electromagnéticas de nuestros diseños electrónicos, una actividad clave para nuestro... equipo que desarrollarás junto con los diseñadores hardware y los expertos de nuestro laboratorio de compatibilidad electromagnética.

¿Qué te aportaremos?
• Trabajar en un equipo dinámico y diverso, donde se respira y se palpa la tecnología del futuro.
• Tener a tu disposición personas expertas con gran conocimiento en la materia dispuestas a ayudarte en tu desarrollo.
• Tener a tu disposición laboratorios de primer nivel, como nuestro laboratorio de compatibilidad electromagnética y el de montaje de PCBs.
• Participar en diseños de hardware retadores, donde pueden combinarse tamaños reducidos, altas densidades de componentes, interfaces de

alta velocidad o potencia y circuitos integrados de última generación, entre otras características singulares.
• Mejorar tus habilidades mediante un plan de formación y trayectoria profesional donde siempre intentamos alinear tus intereses, motivaciones

e inquietudes con los retos del equipo e IKERLAN.
• Incorporarte a un centro tecnológico con 50 años de historia, referente en Euskadi en la transferencia tecnológica a empresas líderes en

diversos sectores industriales tales como el del transporte, el de la transformación, almacenamiento y distribución de energía o el de los

bienes de equipo para la industria 4.0.

Tus funciones serán:
• Participar en todas las fases de desarrollo de nuestros proyectos para garantizar su compatibilidad electromagnética (EMC).
• Desarrollar actividades de diseño, test y validación relacionadas con la compatibilidad electromagnética:
• Diseños eléctricos y electrónicos (esquemáticos, simulaciones, etc).
• Definición de planes de pruebas de EMC.
• Ejecución de planes de prueba y registro de resultados.
• Propuestas de mejora en diseños electrónicos para cumplimiento de EMC.
• Interpretar y aplicar directivas y normativas.
• Participar en nuestras actividades de investigación mediante las que mejoramos el estado del arte de las técnicas, métodos y herramientas de aseguramiento de EMC.

Requisitos:

Para disfrutar en este equipo necesitarás:
• Grado o Máster en Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Sistemas Embebidos, o similar.
• Se valorarán fundamentos en electrónica analógica/digital, electrónica de potencia y electromagnetismo.
• Se valorará experiencia previa en normativas y en ensayos de compatibilidad electromagnética, aunque no es imprescindible

jobs_results.title: Hardware & Firmware Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Desde la división tecnológica de LHH en Andalucía estamos gestionando la búsqueda de un perfil Hardware + Firmware, para uno de nuestros clientes del sector biotecnológico.

Concretamente buscamos un ingeniero electrónico que aporte amplia experiencia en hardware, aunque también necesitaremos que se aporten conocimientos en la parte firmware.

Necesitamos profesionales con experiencia utilizando software de diseño electrónico, concretamente Eagle (también podemos valorar Altium).

En la parte de microcontroladores, principalmente valoraremos conocimiento y experiencia con STM32.

Posición 100% presencial en Sevilla.

Horario flexible: 8 h al día con entrada flexible entre las 7.30 y las 9.30 am.

Desde la división tecnológica de LHH en Andalucía estamos gestionando la búsqueda de un perfil Hardware + Firmware, para uno de nuestros clientes del sector biotecnológico.

Concretamente buscamos un ingeniero electrónico que aporte amplia experiencia en hardware, aunque también necesitaremos que se aporten conocimientos en la parte firmware.

Necesitamos profesionales con experiencia utilizando software de diseño electrónico, concretamente Eagle (también podemos valorar Altium).

En la parte de microcontroladores, principalmente valoraremos conocimiento y experiencia con STM32.

Posición 100% presencial en Sevilla.

Horario flexible: 8 h al día con entrada flexible entre las 7.30 y las 9.30 am.

Si necesitas más detalles sobre el proyecto y condiciones, no dudes en aplicar o contactarme directamente a luis.marquez@lhh.com
